description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 25/04591 ("Variation of conditions 2 (approved drawings) and condition 32 (restricted area of terrace) of planning permission 24/04739 to allow design refinements to the scheme, including: enlarged windows to rear elevation of No 12 to match the aperture sizes at neighbouring No 11; raised front outrigger to Nos 3 & 4 at second floor level; and enlarged rear terraces at GF level to include the removal of the existing balustrades creating a larger rooftop terrace to Nos 2-4") for repositioning of dormer window at No. 2 by around 150mm to match configuration of Nos. 3 & 4 and omission of skylights to front outrigger serving second-floor ensuites of all three properties; amendment to third-floor windows at No. 14 from casement to sash windows to match existing window type; reduction in size of flat roof rooflights to Nos. 13 & 14; updated boundary line between Nos. 13 & 14 to match floorplans.
